scenarios.title: A｜邻居太吵
scenarios.setting: 连续几晚，隔壁都在深夜播放音乐。玩家去敲门。

turns.prompt: 你想礼貌请邻居注意音乐音量，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, sorry to bother you, but the music is a little loud.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, sorry to bother you, but the music is a little loud.
feedback.explanation: “a little”表示少量或轻微程度，适合表达希望只作小幅调整。

choices.text: Would you mind turning the music down a little?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would you mind turning the music down a little?
feedback.explanation: “Would you mind + 动词 -ing”礼貌请求对方做事，给对方表达不便的余地。

choices.text: I can hear the music pretty clearly from my apartment. Could you turn it down?

feedback.naturalExpression: I can hear the music pretty clearly from my apartment. Could you turn it down?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Sorry, but I’m trying to sleep. Would you mind keeping it down?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry, but I’m trying to sleep. Would you mind keeping it down?
feedback.explanation: “Would you mind + 动词 -ing”礼貌请求对方做事，给对方表达不便的余地。

choices.text: You’re making too much noise.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, sorry to bother you, but the music is a little loud.
feedback.explanation: 这句直接评价对方制造太多噪音；说明影响睡眠的具体时段，再请求调低音量更便于合作。

turns.text: Oh, sorry. I didn’t realize it was that loud.

turns.prompt: 你想让对方放轻松，表示理解或不介意，会怎么说？

choices.text: No worries. The walls are probably just a little thin.

feedback.naturalExpression: No worries. The walls are probably just a little thin.
feedback.explanation: 用简短回应表示不介意或愿意体谅，可以减轻对方的歉意。

choices.text: Thanks. I have to get up pretty early tomorrow.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I have to get up pretty early tomorrow.
feedback.explanation: “have to”表示有必要或受条件限制必须这样做，可用于核实办理要求。

choices.text: I appreciate it. It’s just been a little difficult to sleep.

feedback.naturalExpression: I appreciate it. It’s just been a little difficult to sleep.
feedback.explanation: “I appreciate”表达对帮助、坦诚或付出的感谢，后面点明感谢对象更具体。

turns.text: I’ll turn it down. Sorry about that.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks, I really appreciate it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks, I really appreciate it.
feedback.explanation: “appreciate it”是简短感谢，“it”指对方刚提供的帮助。

choices.text: No problem. Thanks for understanding.

feedback.naturalExpression: No problem. Thanks for understanding.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

scenarios.title: B｜自己被投诉
scenarios.setting: 晚上，邻居来敲玩家的门。

turns.text: Hey, sorry to bother you. Could you keep the noise down a little? I can hear the music from my bedroom.

turns.prompt: 你想为刚才的情况致歉或作些说明，会怎么说？

choices.text: Oh, I’m sorry. I didn’t realize it was that loud.

feedback.naturalExpression: Oh, I’m sorry. I didn’t realize it was that loud.
feedback.explanation: “I’m sorry”先表达歉意或遗憾，再说明具体情况，能照顾对方的感受。

choices.text: Sorry about that. I’ll turn it down right away.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry about that. I’ll turn it down right away.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Of course. Thanks for letting me know.

feedback.naturalExpression: Of course. Thanks for letting me know.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: I’m really sorry. Were we keeping you awake?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m really sorry. Were we keeping you awake?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: But it’s not very loud.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Oh, I’m sorry. I didn’t realize it was that loud.
feedback.explanation: 直接否认很吵容易忽略邻居的体验；可以说明自己没意识到，再询问或调整音量。

turns.text: Yeah, a little. I have to work early tomorrow.

turns.prompt: 你想表示理解对方的解释或立场，会怎么说？

choices.text: I understand. We’ll keep it quiet.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand. We’ll keep it quiet.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: Sorry again. I’ll make sure it doesn’t happen again tonight.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry again. I’ll make sure it doesn’t happen again tonight.
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。

choices.text: No problem. We’ll lower the volume.

feedback.naturalExpression: No problem. We’ll lower the volume.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

turns.prompt: 你想友好地结束这段交流，会怎么说？

choices.text: Of course. Have a good night.

feedback.naturalExpression: Of course. Have a good night.
feedback.explanation: 用简短告别为对话收尾，既确认交流结束，也保留友好的语气。

choices.text: Sorry again. Good night.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry again. Good night.
feedback.explanation: “Sorry”可用于礼貌打断或引出更正，后面的具体内容让对方知道需要回应哪一点。

scenarios.title: C｜协商解决
scenarios.setting: 噪音问题反复发生，玩家再次与邻居沟通。

turns.text: Hey, could we talk about the noise for a minute?

turns.prompt: 关于「噪音问题」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’ve been having trouble sleeping because of the noise at night.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve been having trouble sleeping because of the noise at night.
feedback.explanation: “I’ve been”把过去的经历或持续情况与现在联系起来，适合交代背景。

choices.text: The music has been pretty loud several nights this week. Could we work something out?

feedback.naturalExpression: The music has been pretty loud several nights this week. Could we work something out?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

choices.text: I don’t want to cause any problems, but the noise has been keeping me awake.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t want to cause any problems, but the noise has been keeping me awake.
feedback.explanation: “keeping me awake”表示让自己一直无法入睡，说明干扰持续存在。

choices.text: Could we figure out a way to keep things a little quieter at night?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could we figure out a way to keep things a little quieter at night?
feedback.explanation: “figure out”表示想明白或弄清楚，强调经过思考找到办法。

choices.text: You are noisy every night and I can’t accept it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve been having trouble sleeping because of the noise at night.
feedback.explanation: “every night”加上直接指责容易激化矛盾；指出具体噪音及其影响，再请求降低音量，更便于解决问题。

turns.text: Sorry about that. What time is it usually a problem?

turns.prompt: 对方在确认时间或时长，你会怎样补充信息？

choices.text: Mostly after about 11 p.m.

feedback.naturalExpression: Mostly after about 11 p.m.
feedback.explanation: “mostly”限定为主要情况，说明还有其他可能，而不是一概而论。

choices.text: During the day it’s fine. It’s mainly late at night.

feedback.naturalExpression: During the day it’s fine. It’s mainly late at night.
feedback.explanation: 接着上文说明对象的具体情况，指代清楚时无需重复完整名称。

choices.text: Would it be possible to keep the volume lower after eleven?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would it be possible to keep the volume lower after eleven?
feedback.explanation: 先问是否有可能安排，适合需要对方查看余位或规则的请求，语气比直接要求更柔和。

choices.text: I usually go to bed around eleven, so anything after that is pretty noticeable.

feedback.naturalExpression: I usually go to bed around eleven, so anything after that is pretty noticeable.
feedback.explanation: 接着上文说明对象的具体情况，指代清楚时无需重复完整名称。

turns.text: Yeah, that’s reasonable. I’ll keep it down after eleven.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks. I really appreciate you working with me on this.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I really appreciate you working with me on this.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: That would help a lot. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: That would help a lot. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Great. And if I’m ever too loud, please let me know too.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. And if I’m ever too loud, please let me know too.
feedback.explanation: “Let me …”提出由自己来做下一步，能明确谁来采取行动。
